title: GRAD9 | רמת משחק לדוגמה
originalBrief: Continue the existing GRAD_9 scene as the complete sample gameplay level. Connect its current work to the website, including existing waves, routes, towers, real QA and beginning-to-victory acceptance. Preserve GRAD11 and other unsaved Unity work; do not create a replacement level.

gaps.description: No continuous beginning-to-victory Play evidence or multiplayer smoke verification.
A prior preview found 12 active QA tower children; this was not rechecked against the 2026-10-25 saved scene.

The current static overlay summarizes 22 waves, 11 spawn clusters, 1 boss, 5 spline routes, and 4 road routes from WavesManager via timeline.json. Scheduler execution, kill time, and late-wave load remain unmeasured.
A fresh current-scene Level QA timeline and wave projection are now published. They are authoring/static evidence only; runtime route execution and timing remain unverified.
A matching static Level QA capture was generated and published after the 2026-10-25 scene save. Continuous Play evidence is still absent.
gaps.replacementAction: Review this capture, then verify the current scene's gameplay and runtime behavior.
